open_bounded_vetoes.finding: ValueDesireKernel.update calls _apply_time_decay(state) before checking RUNTIME_ONLY_DOMAINS. Therefore every heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/wake invocation decays all fast and slow drive axes by fixed per-call factors. Runtime-only events do not increment Experience counters, but their frequency still changes cognitive drive state and can indirectly alter later desire/goal/personality-candidate outputs. This violates Windchime's event-driven, not heartbeat-count-driven learning invariant.
open_bounded_vetoes.required_change: Decouple cognitive decay from runtime pulse count. Apply decay from an explicit trusted elapsed-time/metabolism clock or bounded reconciliation tick, not once per liveness event. Duplicate/retry/reconnect/wake events with identical elapsed cognitive time must be strict no-ops for drive/personality evidence and state except runtime diagnostics.
